indexFields.characteristic: 需要慎重判断需要使用技能的时机。
indexFields.biography: 张虎，名将张辽之子。承袭父爵，官至偏将军。乐綝[chēn]，右将军乐进的儿子。果毅坚毅，袭封广昌亭侯，累迁扬州刺史。甘露二年，为叛乱的征东大将军诸葛诞所杀

genderEvidence.basis: Historical identity in the official biography; portrait inspection recorded below. This is an inference, not an explicit API gender field.

identifierEvidence.note: The stable romanized key zhang-hu-yue-chen is local, not an advertised official key. The official biography explicitly renders 綝 as chēn; the API supplies numeric gid and Chinese name, without romanizing 乐.

artwork.skinNameOrigin: local catalog label for advertised default portrait
artwork.visualObservation: Two male armored figures in dark blue and gold; foreground figure has a white helmet plume, rear figure a fur collar; grain sacks and a military camp appear behind and below them.

skills.name: 袭爵
skills.text: 游戏开始时，你获得4枚“爵”标记；结束阶段，你获得X枚“爵”（X为你本回合造成的伤害数）。摸牌阶段开始时，你可以移除1枚“爵”发动“突袭”；其他角色的结束阶段，你可以移除1枚“爵”发动“骁果”。
skills.textOrigin: current hero/7000 exact SSR skill-text span

implementationStatus: Content and final shared-contract rules source-ready; runtime verification is performed separately by the coordinating agent.
evidenceLimit: The API advertises initial_hp=0 alongside positive hp. The local ordinary identity definition starts at advertised maximum HP; that zero is not imported as zero starting HP. This is a local interpretation, not an explicit API rule.
The current official ordinary identity version is used. National-war reveal/half-HP text and ten-year variants do not substitute its rules.

The archive retains primary URLs, HTTP status, decoded-body hashes and exact current skill text. Static source readiness does not claim runtime acceptance or an official cross-skill FAQ for inferred implementation details.
Both official API quality values are 稀有. Ordinary here identifies the current identity variant, rather than claiming the website quality is 普通.

The current page says 结束阶段 and 伤害数; the historical official release uses 回合结束 and explains the turn damage quantity. Current wording takes precedence. The exact engine TurnEnding lifecycle and exclusion of source-less attribution are implementation mappings.
Borrowed skill expansion is inferred from current ordinary 张辽 and current OL 乐进 primary pages. Hero7000 itself only names 突袭 and 骁果. These abilities are not permanently granted.

The ending marker total is frozen before its native child resolutions. Later child damage does not retroactively increase this same settlement. This is the shared resolution contract, not a separately verified official recursive-trigger FAQ.

borrowedSkillExpansion.name: 突袭
borrowedSkillExpansion.exactText: 摸牌阶段，你可以改为获得至多两名角色的各一张手牌。
borrowedSkillExpansion.interpretation: Current hero7000 names the skill but does not expand it. This implementation uses current ordinary 张辽 rather than boundary/ten-year variants, with one additional Jue cost.

borrowedSkillExpansion.name: 骁果
borrowedSkillExpansion.exactText: 其他角色的结束阶段，你可以弃置一张基本牌，令其选择一项：1.弃置一张装备牌，你摸一张牌；2.你对其造成1点伤害。
borrowedSkillExpansion.interpretation: Current ordinary OL 乐进 behavior is reused, including hand equipment as a valid response and real awaited cost movement, with one additional Jue cost.

finalRuleMapping.meaning: Freeze the actual current-turn DamageApplied amount total attributable to the owner, excluding source-less damage. Apply the frozen total once across native children and cold recovery; zero does not add.
Optional replacement of ordinary draw by current classic Tuxi, one hand card from each of one or two other living owners with hand cards.
Optional current OL Xiaoguo, with Basic hand cost, foreign Equipment HE response, awaited movement, then owner Draw1 or owner-sourced Damage1.
